training_split: FER2013 Training and VGG-Faces pretraining, as documented in the publisher checkpoint table
model_selection_split: The publisher benchmark defines PublicTest as validation. Historical checkpoint selection details are unavailable.
publisher_reporting_split: FER2013 PublicTest validation and PrivateTest test using original labels
preprocessing: PIL bilinear resize of the 48x48 grayscale crop to 224x224, replication to RGB, and subtraction of [131.45376586914062, 103.98748016357422, 91.46234893798828] from the corresponding channels in [0,255] units. The normalization standard deviations are all 1.
inference: Original Oxford model with strictly loaded checkpoint, evaluation mode, CPU FP32, fold seven Conv-BatchNorm pairs, channels-last layout, batch size 48, and one PyTorch CPU thread.
fp32_reference_check: The original unfused and adapted PyTorch implementations agreed on all 16 native-view top-1 classes checked on PublicTest. The maximum absolute logit difference was 1.48e-5.
view_fusion: Cache logits contain the arithmetic mean of both views. Individual view logits are stored separately.
redistribution: The author offers both checkpoint and architecture as public downloads. No explicit redistribution license was identified for the checkpoint.
prediction_scope: Inference reads source images, IDs and hashes. The pilot additionally uses the PublicTest clean mask. PrivateTest labels are never read by the prediction adapter.
